coverage: Sixteen approved financial function names and two finance timing symbols from round 22. This is a specification catalog, not an implemented parser registry. Future locales add one local spelling alongside the always-active Latin baseline. Round 23 accepts general timing-value behavior, percent display and copying the displayed percentage coefficient divided exactly by 100; see ../../language/value-semantics.md.

finance.loanPayment.monthly.context: Identifier approved in round 22. The Latin name is always accepted; only the active interface locale adds its local name. Case-sensitive names are not inferred from a unit suffix. The positional signature and model binding are specified in ../../language/financial-functions.json. No additional abbreviations or spreadsheet aliases are registered.
finance.loanPayment.monthly.location: Function-name positions in formulas, inline completion and function help. The completion signature follows the name in the same font and size; its description follows after a gap in lighter, reduced-opacity text of the same size.

finance.timing.end.meaning: The end of a calculation period for payments or contributions.
finance.timing.end.context: Round 23 accepts timing as a distinct symbolic value. It can be stored in constants and local variables and passed through or returned by user functions. The protected Latin symbols start/end are always available alongside only the active locale. Equality and inequality between timing values are supported; ordering, arithmetic and numeric 0/1 coercion are rejected. A standalone result displays and copies the active interface-language timing symbol. Ordinary result targeting, grouping and confirmation rules apply.
finance.timing.end.location: Timing-argument positions in financial calls and the corresponding inline completion rows.
